5262.title: Pooled sessions lose cache-account affinity during idle pauses
5262.rootCauseOneLine: A 30-minute idle affinity TTL expires live and persisted session pins before the enabled one-hour Claude cache interval, letting the advanced pool cursor choose another account.
5262.proposedFix: Increase the existing idle affinity TTL to 65 minutes and retain live/reload regressions plus refreshed expiry coverage.
5262.caveats: Real provider cache writes and billing were not measured; account switching is reproduced through the real plugin route with a synthetic upstream.
